environment.description: Same application deployed on EKS with a Pod Security Standard 'restricted' namespace label (pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: restricted). The container runs with readOnlyRootFilesystem: true. The export volume is an emptyDir with medium: Memory (tmpfs) mounted at /var/spool/tenant-exports with a 512Mi sizeLimit. A custom Kubernetes ValidatingAdmissionPolicy (CEL expression) rejects any pod spec containing hostPath volumes or volumeMounts with subPathExpr. Additionally, the node's kubelet is configured with --protect-kernel-defaults=true and the underlying EXT4 filesystem on the node has the 'nosymfollow' mount option applied to /var/spool via a DaemonSet-managed systemd mount unit, which causes all symlink traversals in that path to return ELOOP. The PostgreSQL connection uses a separate IAM-authenticated role per tenant (via IRSA projected token) with RLS policy: CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON records USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant')) WITH CHECK (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant')).

config.validating_admission_policy: deny hostPath and subPathExpr in all pod specs
config.postgres_rls: per-tenant IAM role with row-level policy enforced
